housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of EUR 788.89 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Bari city centre; idealista lists Bari rentals. A deposit norm was not verified.

banking.summary: BPER Banca's official guidance says foreign nationals opening a current account must present a valid passport or identity card and residence permit; a tax code is also required if already assigned to a person who is not an Italian tax resident.
required_docs: Italian tax code if already assigned for a non-Italian tax resident

schools.summary: Istituto Preziosissimo Sangue in Bari offers a bilingual Italian primary programme with Cambridge International School-guided Global Perspectives and English as a Second Language elements; a Bari-wide public/private schools directory is provided.
curricula: Cambridge International School-guided Global Perspectives and English as a Second Language elements within an Italian primary curriculum

legal_admin.summary: A person moving their habitual residence to Bari from abroad must submit a residence declaration to the municipal Registry Office; the official online service requires authentication.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit a declaration of residence to the Comune di Bari Ufficio Anagrafe.

tax_finance.summary: The Italian tax identification number is the codice fiscale. First-time foreign applicants must book an in-person appointment for identity verification; EU citizens may apply at any Revenue Agency office with the request and valid ID, while specified non-EU cases are handled by immigration desks or police headquarters and other cases by the Revenue Agency.

transport.summary: AMTAB operates Bari's local public transport service; its ordinary 30-day pass costs EUR 35. Driving-licence exchange and healthcare-registration details were not included because this schema provides only one service source URL and those facts require separate authorities.
